caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, both with crowns on their heads. The larger figure is a woman with brown hair wearing a blue cloak with yellow trim and a red interior garment, holding a string of white beads or a rosary in her right hand. The woman is seated and holds a smaller child figure, also crowned, with brown hair, a white garment with a red collar, and a yellow and red sash across the body. The child is sitting on the woman's left knee and faces forward, appearing to hold a similar string of white beads or a rosary in its left hand. Both figures have halos behind their heads, the woman's halo being yellow and more pronounced. The background around the figures is filled in with brown and off-white, contained within a red and black arch shape. Below the figures, separated by a horizontal line, is a large stylized plant form with curving dark green, brown, and red fronds or leaves, spreading out symmetrically over a pale background, with a green base at the bottom. The entire composition is bordered by a light brown outline.
title: Retablo - Virgin & Child
